position: Operational observability should measure safety and performance without collecting the question, source passage, or reflection
headline: Four aggregate events prove the control surface while raw content, network, export, and live participation remain absent.
copy: The event contract records only type, time, status, and latency. A named rollback owner and checkpoint digest keep the stop path visible.

postures.title: Events
postures.copy: No custom event or field can enter the fixture.

postures.title: Content
postures.copy: Questions, passages, and reflections stay outside telemetry.

postures.title: Rollback
postures.copy: A human remains accountable for the stop path.

flow.title: Open
flow.copy: Record one local fixture open event.

flow.title: View
flow.copy: Measure source-view latency without source content.

flow.title: Acknowledge
flow.copy: Record only that the boundary was shown.

flow.title: Close
flow.copy: End within thirty minutes and retain a rollback checkpoint.

decisions.label: Allowed fields
decisions.reason: Only type, time, status, and latency.

decisions.label: Raw content
decisions.reason: No user or source text enters observability.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Direct identity fields are rejected by every contract.

locks.title: Execution lock
locks.copy: No invitation, account, credential, participant, or live session is created.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No provider mutation, delivery channel, or exported telemetry exists.

locks.title: Evidence lock
locks.copy: Only fixture evidence and canonical digests are produced.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private evidence review cannot open public access.
